name: MyGeotab MCP
description: Monitor vehicles, analyze trips and driver behavior, and stay on top of safety exceptions, diagnostics, maintenance, EV charging, and compliance across your fleet in MyGeotab. Bring that live data into Claude — then act on it: set up zones and rules, acknowledge faults, and generate reports without leaving the conversation. Surface speeding and utilization trends, answer fleet questions in plain language, and turn insight into action as part of your AI workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MyGeotab MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MyGeotab MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.geotab.com/mygeotab. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MyGeotab MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MyGeotab MCP lists 21 MCP tools, including Add, DecodeVins, DismissFaults, DownloadMediaFile, EmissionEnrollDevices, Get, GetAceResults, GetCountOf, GetDevicesInformation, GetEmissionComplianceDeadline, GetEntity, and GetHosRuleSets.

_published_faq.name: Does MyGeotab MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MyGeotab MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MyGeotab MCP is developed by Geotab. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
